system.description: Spending two Blood Traits, you inscribe an abbreviated version of any Basic or Intermediate ritual you know onto a page written in your own blood. Anyone literate can later trigger the ritual by following the instructions and gathering the normal components, with no Thaumaturgy of their own required. Your maximum blood pool is reduced by one Trait until the inscription is used, at which point the page crumbles to illegible ash.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
